response.original_title: Tentando adiar o fim do mundo
response.overview: Kevin, a young basketball player struggling with grief, guilt, family problems, and the loss of his friend Carol, begins to lose control of his life. After facing bullying, abuse, and conflicts with the people around him, Kevin reaches his breaking point and seeks help. Months later, after rehabilitation, he begins rebuilding his life and learns that delaying the end of the world may simply mean continuing to care, remember, and live.
